component.name: Conduit
component.summary: A terminal built around the flow of information

description.p: Conduit is a modular terminal emulator designed around the flow of information between shells, processes, panes, tabs, windows, workspaces, remote connections, and plugins.

Conduit provides a shared core across graphical, terminal-based, and command-line interfaces while supporting live configuration, shell integration, workspaces, plugins, recording, search, diagnostics, and security controls.
Conduit is designed to keep the shell in control of shell behavior while providing additional context and integration around it.
